work_item: B04 bounded structural JSON comparison with source-located JSON Pointer differences through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This continuation did not request test or runtime-route verification; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonCompare -> ports::json_compare -> JsonComparisonReport artifact
wrapper_schema: Exactly {"left": JSON value, "right": JSON value}; duplicate and unknown fields are rejected.
comparison_rules: Object member order is ignored; decoded object keys are compared exactly and duplicate decoded keys are rejected.
Array order is significant. Decoded JSON strings compare exactly without Unicode normalization; booleans and null compare by value.
JSON number spellings compare by exact bounded rational value, so equivalent decimal/exponent lexemes are equal without binary floating point.
Each difference contains an escaped JSON Pointer and optional left/right source byte ranges and digests relative to the wrapper body.
Missing fields/elements produce ADDED or REMOVED; values/type changes produce CHANGED. Missing and explicit null remain distinct.
Input is limited to 256000 bytes, the shared JSON parser limits nesting/nodes, differences are capped at 4096 and report output at 256000 bytes plus the request output budget.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
